title.en: Sharp front to back, and bright enough

t.zh: <level-ref to="1B5"></level-ref>里对焦不能动，只能靠光圈换景深。这一关新在组合：光圈和对焦距离都能动，两个旋钮互相牵制。两个物体在 1000 mm 和 3000 mm，都要清晰，进光量又不能低于 1。这一关的问题是：既要两个深度都清晰，又要足够的光，对焦该放在哪里？
t.en: In <level-ref to="1B5"></level-ref> the focus was fixed and only the aperture traded depth of field. What is new is the combination: the aperture and the focus distance both turn, and they pull against each other. Two objects stand at 1000 mm and 3000 mm; both must be sharp and the light must not fall below 1. This level asks: with both depths to keep sharp and enough light to gather, where should the focus go?

brief.zh: 同时调光圈和对焦距离：两个物体都清晰，进光量不低于 1。
brief.en: Set the aperture and the focus together: both objects sharp and the light at least 1.

hint.zh: 移动对焦距离时，看曲线低于门槛的那一段跟着往哪里走。
hint.en: As the focus distance moves, watch where the stretch of the curve below the threshold goes.

hint.zh: 清晰范围在对焦距离的两边都有：对焦在一个物体上时，有一边用不上。
hint.en: The sharp range reaches to both sides of the focus: focused on one of the objects, one side goes unused.

why.zh: 对焦在近处，再收光圈直到两个都清晰：进光量只剩 0.25。
why.en: Focusing on the near object and closing down until both are sharp: the light is only 0.25.

why.zh: 光够了，对焦却还在近处：远处的门糊了。
why.en: The light is enough, but the focus is still on the near object: the far door blurs.

why.zh: 对焦挪到远处：近处的人又糊了。
why.en: Moving the focus to the far object: now the near person blurs.
